properties.name: app.frontend-url
properties.description: Frontend origin used for CORS and authentication redirects.

properties.name: app.auth.mail-from
properties.description: Sender email address used for OTP delivery. Configured through MAIL_FROM.

properties.name: app.auth.jwt-secret
properties.description: Base64-encoded JWT signing key containing at least 32 random bytes. Configured through JWT_SECRET; a blank value uses an ephemeral development key.

properties.name: app.cloudinary.cloud-name
properties.description: Cloudinary cloud name for avatar uploads. Configured through CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME.

properties.name: app.cloudinary.api-key
properties.description: Cloudinary API key for server-side avatar uploads. Configured through CLOUDINARY_API_KEY.

properties.name: app.cloudinary.api-secret
properties.description: Cloudinary API secret for server-side avatar uploads. Configured through CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET.
